summary: scripts/check_live.py: with --expect-sha, a /api/version commit that is a strict descendant of the expected commit (git merge-base --is-ancestor, fetching it from origin if needed) now passes with a NOTE, because overlapping pipelines of main deploy in order and a newer deploy proves the expected one was superseded. Older, unrelated, unknown, non-sha values and a missing repository still fail closed. This re-lands the fix of issue 46, whose task file reused id task_103 (already on main). Not fixed: deploy_demo_app greps the same sha in its script in .gitlab-ci.yml, which is human-only.
next: A human may add a resource_group to the deploy jobs or the same descendant check to deploy_demo_app in .gitlab-ci.yml
